summary: Phase 9 (Payment + Advice) backend testing complete. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase9_payments.py with 38 pytest tests covering: PaymentModes seed (exactly CASH/BANK/MOBILE_UPI, no ONLINE/Razorpay row), eligible-purchases preview + SINGLE/DATE_RANGE/FARMER selection modes, loan auto-deduction math (no-loan, loan-bigger-than-payable capped, multi-loan FIFO oldest-first, exact-match closes loan), cancel reversal + repay creating brand-new PaymentId+AdviceNumber with fresh deduction, cancel short-reason 400 and double-cancel 409, idempotency 409, Cash Evidence captureQueued flag (true only for CASH), images list + manual capture endpoints, print preview (PNG/PDF bytes, no counter change) vs final (counter +1 on repeat), Payment list/Get filters + purchaseIds array, RBAC 403s for Operator/SalePurchase/Admin(Create+Cancel)/Farmer-scope, Accountant Create success. Final run: 38/38 passed in 53s.

minor.issue: Rate-limit 429 easily triggered on rapid successive logins (test/user provisioning); tests use retry-with-backoff. Not a Phase-9 regression, pre-existing.

action_items: None blocking. All Phase-9 gaps flagged in the review request are covered and passing.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentControllers.cs is ~408 lines - within budget but growing. If Phase 10 adds SMS/gateway logic to Issue(), consider extracting the FIFO loan-deduction loop and eligibility scoping into a PaymentService in Application layer.
PaymentController.Cancel accepts `Dictionary<string,string>` for body - a typed DTO (`PaymentCancelRequest { Reason }`) would be more idiomatic and give better Swagger docs / validation.
Idempotency uses in-memory IMemoryCache (10-min window). Fine for single-node dev; needs distributed cache (Redis) for horizontal scale, but consistent with Loan module (Phase 8 has same pattern).

LoanRecovery.PaymentId FK cascade behavior not verified: if a Payment row were ever hard-deleted, cancel logic would break. Soft-delete via PaymentStatus=CANCELLED is the correct path and is enforced (never DELETE) - keep it that way.

captureQueued=true fires a fire-and-forget BackgroundService task (QueueCapture); test only validates the response flag not that the JPEG actually landed on disk (no cameras configured in container). Acceptable given CANE_CAMERA_SIMULATOR=true design.

Money math uses WeightCalculator.R2 (2-decimal rounding) consistently in FIFO loop; verified sum(deductions)+netPayable == totalPurchaseAmount exactly in test_loan_bigger_than_payable_capped and test_multi_loan_fifo_oldest_first.

success_rate.frontend: n/a (Flutter, no SDK in container per request)

test_credentials: developer / DevSecure@2026 (already forced-change done). Test users provisioned by suite: phase9_acct/Acct@2026, phase9_op/Oper@2026, phase9_sp/Sale@2026, phase9_admin/Adm@2026, and one dynamic phase9_farmA_<mobile>/Farm@2026 per run.
seed_data_creation: Suite creates ~15 fresh TEST_ growers (unique mobile per run) + one purchase each via full weighment gross+tare, plus a few TEST loans. All prefixed TEST_ for future cleanup. Existing seeded grower 101/1 and payments id 1/2 from prior smoke test untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_phase9_payments.py -n 0 -v` (serialize; parallel causes 429 auth rate-limits during user provisioning, same as Phase 8). All fixtures are module-scoped, tests are self-provisioning (create their own grower+purchase+loan). Fresh DB not required - suite uses unique mobiles per run to avoid cross-run loan-state pollution. Existing Payment id 1 (CANCELLED, Advice 1) and Payment id 2 (COMPLETED, Advice 2) from author's manual smoke are relied upon by TestCashEvidence::test_images_list_empty_when_no_cameras_or_disabled and TestListAndGet::test_filter_by_advice_number - if DB is wiped these will still pass because suite creates its own additional payments too. Two occasional intermittent runs saw ~6 fails/8 errors under rate-limit contention; a clean serialized run passes 38/38 in 53s.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Author's manual smoke coverage + this suite's additional coverage fully exercise the Phase-9 requirements. Multi-loan FIFO correctly settles oldest first (test_multi_loan_fifo_oldest_first: 5000 loan CLOSED, 20000 loan reduced by (payable-5000)). Loan-bigger-than-payable correctly caps deduction at payable amount (test_loan_bigger_than_payable_capped: 50000 loan -> deducted amt=purchase_amount, remainder ACTIVE). Cancel-then-repay correctly gets a NEW AdviceNumber (assert p2.adviceNumber != p1.adviceNumber). Idempotency 10-min window blocks duplicate POST with 409. RBAC matrix verified: Accountant can Create, Admin cannot Create/Cancel but can View, Operator/SalePurchase blocked on all Payment endpoints. Farmer scoping via Grower.Mobile==User.Mobile confirmed - other growers' payments neither listed nor gettable-by-id (404, not 403, which prevents existence leakage as intended per controller comment).
